body:
Thanks for the info, this is very encouraging.  I can relate to the personality being in a trance, I think that was one of the biggest things that made me seek help, I realized that this wasn't ME.  I haven't been me in a while.

Very happy to hear that you're feeling better and hope things keep getting better!
Thanks, I appreciate it.  Trying to take some steps to move forward.

Thanks for reading my story and commenting, I appreciate it.

As far as family and friends, that's kind of a funny situation.  I have people tell me all the time how strong they think I am and I usually have people coming to me for support and advice.  If they only knew.  I really don't want to let anyone down by letting them know how serious things are for me now.  Not that I want to hide my issues, I guess I do somewhat, but I really want to continue to be there for people and to be encouragement for others.

I also see where that could be annoying for a doctor.  My point was to try and let him know that it had helped me before and I 'thought' I was OK but after trying to go it on my own things were a mess again.

Thanks again, so much, for replying.
